messages:
Elaine: Thinking about a different webinar structure: 'Prompt Clinic + Labs' — short framing, then hands-on sandboxes where attendees run a preset prompt across two configs, finish with a capstone demo. want fewer slides, more concrete takeaways. open to feedback.

Matt: sounds great. target length? we should set expectations up front (what the labs require).

Elaine: 80 minutes. plan: 15m framing (why serving decisions matter), 40m breakout labs (attendees pick a lane: low-latency, cost-optimized, quality-first), 20m capstone demos + 5m wrap. labs run with prebuilt sandboxes and a small checklist.

Sanju: infra note: we need ephemeral sandboxes with pinned model versions + token quotas. recommend staging Dedicated pool with a provisioning script and a global token cap to avoid noisy tenants.

Sanju: sandbox CLI snippet (staging):
```bash
# create ephemeral sandbox for attendee workshop
redwoodctl sandbox create --model redwood-vicuna-13b-q4 --ttl 75m --token-quota 4000 --label webinar-sandbox-2026
```

Oliver: we should pre-record a 3-min failover demo (switch to hosted small model + recorded explanation) in case sandboxes spike or GPUs degrade.

Leah: leads: capture lane choice + infra interest (hosted/dedicated/private) and company size. route to separate nurture paths in HubSpot. also add an opt-in for a trial.

Leah: suggested payload mapping for automation:
```json
{ "email": "", "lane": "low-latency|cost|quality", "infra_interest": "hosted|dedicated|private", "company_size": "<50|50-500|>500", "trial_opt_in": "yes|no" }
```

Jess: speakers: Elaine intro; Sanju infra clinic; customer case (5m) showing real metrics; Matt to moderate capstone. i can ping two customers. keep abstracts short (2 paragraphs: what they demo + 3 takeaways).

Matt: rehearsal plan: 30m run-through focused on onboarding flow + sandbox CLI, then 15m tech check day-before. we need a clear click-path doc for attendees.

Elaine: tentative schedule: audience blurb Tue, speakers confirmed Thu, sandbox checklist Mon next week, failover pre-recorded by Fri. rehearsals Wed 11:00-11:30 and day-before 09:00-09:15.

Sanju: i'll provision 12 sandboxes in staging and publish the provisioning guide + script. will add autoscale buffer and set global token cap for the workshop window.

Oliver: i'll record failover clip and drop into ops playbook.

Jess: i'll handle speaker outreach and collect abstracts. will keep them to 2 paragraphs.

Leah: i'll build the lead form + mapping and wire the flows to HubSpot. also propose a 1-question post-event micro-survey (which config they preferred).

deploy-bot: Notice: Maintenance on inference-dedicated-pool scheduled 2026-05-02 02:00-02:30 UTC. Some sandboxes may degrade during that window.

Elaine: good catch @deploy-bot — we'll avoid that window. final step: everyone drop a one-line owner confirmation and i'll assemble the ops checklist + attendee email template.

Matt: i'll own tech run-throughs and moderate live.

Sanju: i'll own sandbox provisioning & quota policy.

Leah: i'll own lead capture & automation.

Jess: i'll own speaker confirmations & abstracts.

Oliver: i'll own the failover recording.

Elaine: thanks all — i'll post the attendee-facing blurb this afternoon and add the ops checklist to the shared folder. :rocket:
